implementationScope: Export MagazineRoundConsumptionResult interface in src/game/domain/index.ts containing readonly magazineAmmo: MagazineAmmoState and readonly depletionResponse: AmmoDepletionResponse | null
Export resolveMagazineRoundConsumption(currentAmmo, currentWeaponAction, currentPosture): MagazineRoundConsumptionResult in src/game/domain/index.ts
Implement internal unexported helper consumeMagazineRound(currentAmmo: MagazineAmmoState): MagazineAmmoState in src/game/domain/index.ts
Enforce runtime type validation via assertMagazineAmmo, assertWeaponAction, and assertCharacterPosture throwing TypeError on malformed inputs

Enforce transition preconditions uniformly for N > 1 and N = 1: currentWeaponAction.action === WeaponAction.FIRING, currentPosture.posture === CharacterPosture.EXPOSED, and currentAmmo.current >= 1, throwing Error on violations without clamping or no-op
For N > 1: return frozen MagazineRoundConsumptionResult with magazineAmmo.current = N - 1 and depletionResponse = null
For N = 1: return frozen MagazineRoundConsumptionResult with magazineAmmo.current = 0 and depletionResponse delegated to resolveAmmoDepletionResponse(currentWeaponAction, currentPosture)
Preserve input state immutability and existing resolveAmmoDepletionResponse behavior unchanged
Add unit tests in tests/game-domain.test.ts covering N > 1, N = 1, immutability, freezing, precondition errors, TypeError validation, and unexported helper boundary
